limitations_accepted: F3 - no bounded metrics/diagnostic-status surface. Consequence: no in-product queue/provider health view. Evidence: docs/limitations.md F3.
F4 - reconciliation coverage bounded by QueueCapacity (512). Consequence: a scope larger than the queue covers only a bounded prefix per run. Evidence: docs/limitations.md F4.
F5 - host-supplied SkiaSharp, no bundled fallback. Consequence: a host without a compatible SkiaSharp fails closed (current artwork preserved). Evidence: docs/limitations.md F5; ADR-015.
V1 - no live Sonarr/Radarr release instance. Consequence: release payload-shape variance beyond the committed fixtures is untested. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V1.
V2 - non-canonical cross-runtime comparison unselected/unrun. Consequence: the tolerance half of the ADR-010 oracle is not executed. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V2.
V3 - Jellyfin Enhanced coexistence contract-level only. Consequence: live overlap behavior in an Enhanced install is unverified. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V3.
V4 - live SaveImage read-back manual. Consequence: no automated live HTTP round-trip test. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V4.
V5 - live uninstall drain not automated. Consequence: manual evidence only (task 14.3 and this audit exercised it successfully). Evidence: docs/limitations.md V5.
V6 - guarded facts skip without flags. Consequence: the default run does not exercise host/native paths; the documented matrix names the guards and counts. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V6.

P1 - byte-reproducibility pinned-toolchain-dependent; no automated byte-identity guard. Consequence: a different SDK could change archive bytes; manual re-package verification required. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P1.
P2 - reduced debug metadata. Consequence: harder source-level debugging of the released assembly. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P2.
P3 - PackagePlugin=true stages but does not archive. Consequence: callers must use ./build.sh package. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P3.
P4 - SkiaSharp notices ship without the SkiaSharp runtime. Consequence: none (deliberate attribution). Evidence: docs/limitations.md P4.

P5 - orphaned pre-release state/ incomplete-drain retention. Consequence: manual handling of an unreleased developer data folder; incomplete drains retain the state root by design. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P5.
P6 - v1.1 publication pending the user's manual step. Consequence: no catalog-install or GitHub-download claim holds until publish. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P6.
D1 - webhook 401 ProblemDetails body versus ADR-012 wording. Consequence: generic framework body; no sensitive detail. Evidence: docs/limitations.md D1.
D2 / SEC-6 - ArtworkSubjectGate no idle eviction. Consequence: process-lifetime growth bounded by distinct library items. Evidence: docs/limitations.md D2/SEC-6.
RR-1 - Phases 1-3 lacked independent phase-review records. Consequence: process/evidence gap, not a demonstrated defect. Evidence: docs/limitations.md RR-1.
RR-15 - mock fixture keys in tracked documentation. Consequence: none (local test values; artifact clean). Evidence: docs/limitations.md RR-15.
SEC-2 - shared-temp state-root fallback (LOW, open). Consequence: if engaged, state would live under a shared temp path; unreachable on the pinned host. Evidence: docs/limitations.md SEC-2.
SEC-3 - envelope hash covers only PayloadJson. Consequence: corruption detector, not a tamper MAC; local write access is the boundary. Evidence: docs/limitations.md SEC-3.
SEC-4 - framework ProblemDetails auth error body. Consequence: the D1 wording gap; no sensitive detail. Evidence: docs/limitations.md SEC-4.
SEC-5 - secrets at rest only in Jellyfin config XML; logging bounded/redacted. Consequence: none; reviewed design with the SEC-14.4-05 producer-invariant nuance. Evidence: docs/limitations.md SEC-5.
SEC-7 - authenticated non-JSON content type -> bounded 400. Consequence: valid JSON with an unrelated content type is rejected; Sonarr/Radarr unaffected. Evidence: docs/limitations.md SEC-7.
SEC-8 - no per-client auth throttling on the anonymous webhook route. Consequence: optional post-V1 hardening; mitigated by secret entropy/bounds. Evidence: docs/limitations.md SEC-8.

SEC-9 - configuration-rejection activity-log surface. Consequence: a bounded, secret-free, admin-only notification; repeated invalid saves produce repeated entries (SEC-9.3-02). Evidence: docs/limitations.md SEC-9.

SEC-10 - configured secret lengths unbounded (LOW). Consequence: memory amplification on the anonymous webhook path from an extreme admin-saved secret; no credential disclosure. Evidence: docs/limitations.md SEC-10.
SEC-11 - EnabledLibraries unbounded/unvalidated (LOW). Consequence: oversized/thermal list work and silent fail-closed scope; admin-only trigger. Evidence: docs/limitations.md SEC-11.
SEC-12 - base-URL user information accepted (INFORMATIONAL). Consequence: framework HttpClient logging outside the plugin gate could include such a URI. Evidence: docs/limitations.md SEC-12.

SEC-11.1-1/2/3 - inventory-cache producer invariant, conservative byte estimate, name-heuristic guard (LOW). Consequence: bounded; record cap is the hard bound. Evidence: docs/implementation/11.1/security-review.json.

P12R-F1 - default-fingerprint pin only in the forced-native path (MEDIUM). Consequence: a default-fingerprint regression would not fail the default suite; the forced-native release-matrix leg and live run cover the shipped output. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P12R-F1.
V11-G1 - allowlist not live-exercised (LOW). Consequence: one unexercised live facet; implementation/test-verified. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V11-G1.
V11-G2 - phase residual bundle. Consequence: bounded test-strength/record/UX debt. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V11-G2.
V11-G3 - carried RR101-1/RR101-2 LOWs. Consequence: README install caveat absent pre-publish; publish script fail-slow. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V11-G3.
V11-G4 - stale pre-14.3 phrasing (LOW). Consequence: understated completed verification; no overclaim. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V11-G4.
